persona: Medical representative with four years in a cardio-diabetic division
resumeText:
Rohit Yadav | Lucknow | rohit.yadav@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Medical Representative, Avadh Lifecare Pvt Ltd (cardio-diabetic division), Lucknow (2022 - present)
- Call on 180 doctors on the master call list with a doctor call average of 11 per day.
- Detailed three diabetes brands to physicians and cardiologists using visual aids and clinical papers.
- Generated new prescriptions from 40 doctors for the lead metformin combination brand.
- Run a monthly RCPA at 25 chemists to check prescription uptake by brand.
- Visit 6 chemists a day to check stock and book orders for the stockist.
- Collect monthly stock statements from two stockists and flag near-expiry returns.
- Cover the Lucknow headquarter and the Barabanki and Sitapur outstation territory every month.
- Submit daily call reports and the monthly tour programme in the company app.
- Achieved 108% of the annual primary sales target and grew secondary sales by 15% in 2025.

Medical Sales Trainee, Gomti Healthcare, Lucknow (2021 - 2022)
- Joined senior representatives on doctor calls and chemist visits in Lucknow city.

SKILLS
Therapy area knowledge (diabetes, hypertension), Excel

EDUCATION
BSc Biotechnology, University of Lucknow, 2021
